newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Inmates riot at two Brazil prisons, seize hostages.
newsitem.headline: Inmates riot at two Brazil prisons, seize hostages.

text.p: Inmates seized 20 guards at two prisons in southern Brazil on Tuesday and threatened to kill hostages at one facility if police tried to raid it, authorities said.

Prisoners armed with stilletos, hammers and skewers seized eight guards at a jail in Florianopolis, Santa Catarina state capital. They climbed on the roof with banners demanding the director's ouster while police surrounded the prison.

"A judge is negotiating with them right now," Police Major Mario Cesar de Oliveira told Reuters. "There has been no violence, no injuries or damage." By nightfall the inmates were still in control of the jail.
Meanwhile, three inmates at a maximum security jail at Hortolandia in Sao Paulo state seized 12 guards on Tuesday morning, demanding to be transferred, state officials said.
The uprisings were the third and fourth this week at Brazil's notoriously overcrowded prisons and the second in two days at the Florianopolis State Penitentiary.
Three inmates were killed on Monday when prisoners at Praia Grande in Sao Paulo state rioted after authorities foiled their attempt to tunnel their way to freedom.

On Sunday, inmates at Florianopolis rose up and took two hostages, holding them for 20 hours before striking a deal to end the revolt on Monday. Nine prisoners were transferred to other facilities as part of the agreement.
